name: Booking Grid — Default / Nothing-Selected State (ตารางจองคอร์ทแบดมินตัน — สถานะเริ่มต้น)
purpose: The entry point of the booking flow: a 6-court × time-block availability matrix for a chosen date, where the gang leader taps an empty cell to start a reservation. This is the "Booking Grid: Default State" (PRD Screen 58) — nothing is selected yet, so the bottom drawer is in its instructional/disabled state.
layout: Mobile LIFF shell rendered at 565×1600 px (body min-height: max(884px,100dvh), width 100vw). Fixed frosted header (h-16, bg-surface/80 + backdrop-blur-xl) with home icon, venue name + open-hours pill, and 32px capybara avatar. main has pt-16 pb-24. Top-to-bottom: (1) title block "จองคอร์ทแบดมินตัน" + oat chip + subtitle, with a 40px circular calendar_month button on the right; (2) month label row "พฤษภาคม 2567" / "เลื่อนเลือกวัน" hint; (3) horizontally scrollable 14-day date strip (min-w 58px pills, gap 10px); (4) legend strip in a rounded-xl surface-container-low bar with 4 status keys; (5) peak-rate notice row (oat pill + right-aligned caption); (6) the court matrix — a rounded-2xl white card (shadow-md, overflow-hidden) containing an overflow-x-auto region with min-w-[590px]: sticky header row of 6 court columns (grid-cols-6, gap-1) plus a fixed w-20 "เวลา" column on the left, then 11 time rows divided by divide-y. Grid has mb-20. A fixed bottom drawer sits at bottom-16 (above the nav) on a gradient-to-t fade, and a fixed bottom nav (h-16) with 4 tabs closes the page.

notes: MISSING TIME ROWS: the matrix jumps 11:00 → 13:00 → 15:00 → 17:00. The 12:00-13:00, 14:00-15:00 and 16:00-17:00 rows simply do not exist in the markup, so the grid is not a continuous 09:00–22:00 schedule despite the header claiming those hours. PRD CONTRADICTIONS: PRD §Module 1 specifies Courts 1–12 across 17:00–23:00 at 260 THB/hr; this screen shows 6 courts, 09:00–22:00, ฿180 standard / ฿220 peak. PRICE CONFLICT WITH SIBLING GRID: folder "2." prices the same standard hours at ฿160, not ฿180. COURT-SURFACE CONFLICT: here every court is rubber (ยางเขียว 1-3, ยางน้ำเงิน 4-6); folder "2." calls courts 3 & 4 ปาร์เกต์ (parquet) and courts 5 & 6 fan-cooled; folder _3 calls court 4 พื้นปาร์เกต์. SEMANTIC COLOR SWAP vs sibling: here booked = red error-container and maintenance = gray; in "2." it is inverted (booked = gray, maintenance = red). JS BUG: the deselect branch always restores `text-[#606C38]` (olive), so deselecting a peak ฿220 cell leaves it green instead of `text-secondary`. NO REAL SELECTION MODEL: clicking cells never enables the CTA, never sums a price, and there is no multi-hour/consecutive-hour logic — the PRD's "2 consecutive hours with dynamic price calculation" is only mocked statically in folder "2.". Booked/maintenance cells are <div>s or non-disabled elements, so they are not keyboard-reachable/announced as disabled. All availability is hardcoded mock data; the avatar is a remote lh3.googleusercontent.com placeholder that will 404 offline. Bottom-nav label "จองคอร์ด" is a typo for "จองคอร์ท" and is repeated verbatim in all four folders. Design-system drift: DESIGN.md defines Honey Oat #DDA15E and Olive Meadow #606C38 as tokens, but the Tailwind config ships secondary #835418 / tertiary #131a00 and the file hardcodes #606C38 inline; the PRD's court-green #2e7d32/#10b981 appears nowhere. Also `no-scrollbar` class is referenced but never defined (only a global ::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none} exists).

purpose: The 100%-full fallback for the booking grid: instead of an unusable all-red matrix, the day is replaced by a sleeping-capybara empathy state that recommends the next day with open slots and offers a waitlist notification. This is PRD Screen 57 "Booking Grid: Fully Booked & Alternative" and the Alternate Day Recommendation Engine.

No booking matrix is rendered at all on this screen.

notes: IDENTITY: folder name is opaque ('winner_court_1') but this is unambiguously the Court Profile / venue landing page — PRD Screen 52. PRD CONTRADICTIONS: (a) parking is 'ที่จอดรถ 30 คัน' vs PRD 'Parking (50+ cars)'; (b) venue advertises 6 courts and 09:00–22:00 hours vs PRD's 'Court 1–12' grid over 17:00–23:00 blocks; (c) rates are ฿180 off-peak / ฿220 peak vs PRD's stated 260 THB/hr example; (d) PRD's amenity list names a 'Cafe & Boba counter' and 'lighting lux rating' — neither appears (boba is central to PRD's wager mechanic elsewhere); (e) the PRD asks for 'Map & directions with direct Google Maps integration' but the link is the bare https://maps.google.com homepage, not a place/pin URL; (f) star rating and '142 รีวิว' are a reviews feature that appears nowhere in the PRD. INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY: the banner says '5 ช่วงเวลา' (5 TIME SLOTS) while the two rows underneath total 3 courts + 2 courts = 5 COURTS across only 2 time bands — the unit is wrong, and empty_state/ repeats the same '5 ช่วงเวลา' figure but renders 3 slot chips. CROSS-SCREEN PRICE CONFLICT: empty_state/ prices คอร์ท 3 at ฿200/hr for 19:00–20:00 and คอร์ท 4 at ฿180/hr for 21:00–22:00, both of which fall inside this screen's ฿220 peak band (17:00–22:00). ASSET REUSE BUG: the very same lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida/AEtjO1VwLPjUC3… image is used three times with three different meanings — the header 'Profile' avatar, the 32px 'Winner Court Mascot' next to the H1, and the 10%-opacity watermark in the navy banner; there is no distinct venue logo. All carousel photos are temporary Stitch AB6AXu… URLs that will expire. QUALITY: the carousel has no autoplay, no prev/next buttons and no keyboard affordance (swipe-only); the class 'no-scrollbar' is applied but never defined (it happens to work only because of the global ::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}); both CTAs are dead href='#' with a data-path='court-reserve' hint for a future router; the sticky CTA bar is pinned at bottom-16 which will collide with the nav on devices with a large safe-area inset. Shares the 'จองคอร์ด' (should be 'คอร์ท') nav typo with all other files.

name: Booking Review & Checkout — ยืนยันข้อมูลการจอง (Step 1 of 3)
purpose: The pre-payment review sheet: confirms the selected court/date/2-hour peak slot, itemizes the ฿440 total, shows the LINE-linked contact profile with an editable emergency phone, lets the user pick between paying online (PromptPay QR / card) or cash at the counter, states the cancellation policy, and commits via a sticky total + CTA bar. This is PRD Screen 50 (Booking Confirmation Sheet), the step that precedes the PromptPay QR screen.
layout: ~390–435px mobile viewport. FIXED TOP APP BAR (same as all four files). MAIN pt-16 pb-24, content px-4 pb-16 with gap 1rem, top-to-bottom: (1) Flow nav row — 40px circular back button (arrow_back_ios_new) on the left, centered two-line title 'ยืนยันข้อมูลการจอง' / 'ขั้นตอน 1 จาก 3', right-hand 40px slot holding a honey pill 'รอบ 4'. (2) Booking summary card (white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-4): left column — stadium icon + venue name, then a wrapping chip row (navy pill 'คอร์ท 3 (พื้นยางเกรด BWF)' with a honey dot + grey pill 'ห้องปรับอากาศ' with ac_unit icon); right — 48px rounded court thumbnail; below, a 2-column #f5f3ef inset grid ('วันที่เล่น' → 'ศุกร์ 24 พ.ค. 2567' | 'เวลา (ช่วงพีค)' → '19:00 - 21:00 น.'); footer row with a timelapse duration line and a honey 'Peak Hour Slot' pill. (3) Price breakdown card (white): header 'รายละเอียดค่าบริการ' + 'สกุลเงิน THB (฿)'; two line-item rows; 1px #eae8e4 divider; total row with 'ยอดรวมสุทธิ' / 'รวมภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่มแล้ว' on the left and ฿440 rendered at display-lg-mobile 32px bold on the right. (4) Contact card (white): header + olive-dot pill 'เชื่อมต่อผ่าน LINE แล้ว'; a #f5f3ef profile pill row (40px avatar, name, LINE ID, trailing check_circle); labelled phone field — 48px input with an absolutely positioned 'call' icon at left-3.5, pl-11, shadow-inner, prefilled '081-234-5678'. (5) Payment selector: header row + two full-width stacked option cards, each = 40px icon tile + title with a small tag + subtitle + a 24px circular radio indicator on the right, plus a hairline-separated footer row of two micro-facts. The first card carries ring-2 ring-primary and a filled navy radio with a check. (6) Cancellation callout strip (#f5f3ef rounded-xl, info icon + one-line policy). (7) Centered low-emphasis mascot goodwill line. (8) STICKY bottom drawer (sticky bottom-2, rounded-2xl, bg-white/95 backdrop-blur, shadow-xl): left 'ยอดชำระทั้งหมด' over ฿440 at headline-lg 28px, right a flex-1 50px navy CTA. (9) FIXED BOTTOM NAV, 4 tabs.

notes: IDENTITY: this is 'My Bookings — Empty State' (PRD Screen 47). RELATED, NOT DUPLICATE: _3/ is the only other file containing 'การจองของฉัน' and is the populated Active & History version (Screen 48) — the two should share the header/segmented-control anatomy. PRD ALIGNMENT: correctly uses Capybara Pose 1 (idle, sitting, holding a racket) per the PRD's empty-state rule. PRD/CROSS-SCREEN CONTRADICTIONS: (a) slot prices ฿180 (17:00–18:00), ฿200 (19:00–20:00) and ฿180 (21:00–22:00) all fall inside winner_court_1's 17:00–22:00 peak band priced at ฿220/hr — three of three prices are wrong against the rate card, and ฿200 is a price point that exists nowhere else in the design set; (b) the header claims 'เหลือ 5 ช่วงเวลา' but only 3 slot chips render (same phantom '5' as winner_court_1); (c) PRD grid hours are 17:00–23:00 with courts 1–12 — this shows 17:00–22:00 and courts 1/3/4 only. COPY CONFLICT ON THE SAME SCREEN: the trust badge promises 'ล็อคคอร์ททันที ไม่ต้องรอแอดมินตอบแชท' (no waiting for an admin) while the card below offers 'ทักแอดมิน LINE' (message the admin) — the empty state undercuts the core value proposition. IMPLEMENTATION BUGS: the refresh button has an aria-label but no handler; the tab JS restyles but swaps no content and sets no aria-selected; the bottom-nav markup declares 'จองคอร์ด' as aria-current='page' while the inline JS immediately activates 'ประวัติจอง' instead — the source of truth is contradictory and aria-current is never updated; 'py-0.2' and 'space-y-space-2xs' appear on elements as invalid/undefined utility classes; slot chips look like buttons but are plain divs. MOCK ASSETS: the capybara is a temporary Stitch lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida/… PNG (in the render, the racket head draws as an oversized open loop — the illustration is not the clean vector the DESIGN.md 'clean line work' rule calls for), and the header avatar is a different temporary URL. The 'ทักแอดมิน LINE' link points at the generic https://line.me rather than a LINE OA deep link. Shares the 'จองคอร์ด' (should be 'จองคอร์ท') nav typo with all other files.

notes:
MOCK/PLACEHOLDER: The QR is a hand-drawn decorative SVG (fixed rects + a `path` of blobs + a circle) — it encodes nothing and would not scan; the PRD's "dynamic PromptPay QR with unique checksum" (EMVCo payload) is not represented. Profile avatar is a `lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida/...` throwaway URL. Tax ID 0105562089421 and phone 081-234-5678 are placeholders.
BUGS: (1) The copy button is labelled "คัดลอกเลขบัญชี" (copy ACCOUNT number) but its handler copies `#account-number`, which holds the TAX ID — wrong data, wrong label. (2) The countdown renders as "09:42 น." — "น." is the Thai clock-time suffix (o'clock), grammatically wrong for a mm:ss duration; it reads as "9:42 AM". (3) Timer seeds at 9:42 not 10:00, so the PRD's "10-minute expiry" is off by 18 s and there is no expiry handling beyond freezing at 00:00. (4) The comment says "Sticky Bottom CTA Section" but nothing is sticky. (5) `viewbox` (lowercase) instead of `viewBox` on the SVG — works only because the HTML parser lowercases attributes; will break if ported to JSX/React verbatim.
PRD CONTRADICTIONS: (a) A "บัตรเครดิต / เดบิต" tab exists — the PRD Module 2 only specifies a PromptPay QR engine + bank webhook; card payments are nowhere in the PRD, scope creep with no backing screen. (b) Total ฿440 for 19:00–21:00 implies 220 THB/hr; the PRD explicitly cites 260 THB/hr (which would be ฿520). (c) Header says "เปิดบริการ 09:00 - 22:00" while PRD Module 1 defines the booking grid as 17:00–23:00 blocks — the venue hours and the bookable hours disagree, and this header is copy-pasted into all four screens. (d) No booking reference (`#WC-202410-B84`) appears anywhere; the sibling split-bill screens use a different format `#WN-2405-3`. (e) The status banner promises "ไม่ต้องส่งสลิป" (no slip needed, auto-confirm) yet the primary CTA is a manual "แจ้งว่าชำระเงินแล้ว / ตรวจสอบยอด" — the two contradict each other on the same screen.
SHARED-CHROME ISSUE: the bottom tab label "จองคอร์ด" is a spelling error (คอร์ด = musical chord) for "จองคอร์ท"; it is duplicated verbatim in all four files of this group.
